tasks.title: Writing lines to a file
tasks.statement: Write a function write_lines(path, lines) that writes each string of the list to the file on its own line (utf-8 encoding).
tasks.hint: with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: for line in lines: f.write(line + '\n').

tasks.title: Reading lines
tasks.statement: Write a function read_lines(path) that returns the list of the file's lines without the newline characters.
tasks.hint: with open(...) as f: return [line.strip() for line in f], or read().splitlines().

tasks.title: Words in a file
tasks.statement: Write a function count_words(path) that returns the total number of words in the file (words are separated by spaces and newlines).

tasks.title: A log
tasks.statement: Write a function append_log(path, text) that appends text and a newline to the end of the file without wiping what was there.
tasks.hint: Mode 'a' appends; 'w' would have wiped everything.

tasks.title: Word frequencies in a file
tasks.statement: Write a function word_freq(path) that returns a dictionary of word to count for the words in the file, ignoring case (convert to lowercase).
tasks.hint: counts[w] = counts.get(w, 0) + 1 for each word in line.lower().split().

tasks.title: Reading without crashing
tasks.statement: Write a function safe_read(path) that returns the file's text, or None if there is no such file (FileNotFoundError).
tasks.hint: try: with open(...) as f: return f.read() / except FileNotFoundError: return None.

tasks.title: Uppercase copy
tasks.statement: Write a function copy_upper(src, dst) that reads the file src and writes the same lines to dst in uppercase. Open both files in a single with.
tasks.hint: with open(src, encoding='utf-8') as r, open(dst, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as w: ...

tasks.title: The longest line
tasks.statement: Write a function longest_line(path) that returns the longest line of the file without its newline (the first one if lengths tie). The file is not empty.
tasks.hint: Go through the lines and update the best one only on a strictly greater length.
